findings.fix: Generalise `exists_mapsTo_of_mapsTo_image` to one shared lemma. It takes a compact `Q` in any topological space and `P := Q \ f ⁻¹' S` with `y ∈ S`, plus the hypotheses `hf`, `hinj`, `hp`, `hkc`, `hki`, `hkid`, `hkP`. It returns `g` with `ContinuousOn g Q`, `∀ x ∈ Q, f (g x) = k (f x)`, `g` mapping `Q \ f⁻¹'{y}` into `P`, and `g x = x` on `Q ∩ f⁻¹'{y}`. Use it in both `exists_mapsTo_of_isOpen` and `isCellularSet_preimage_singleton`, and delete the copy.
findings.issue: `exists_continuousOn_mapsTo_injOn` copies `exists_mapsTo_of_mapsTo_image` (InverseSet.lean:207): the same `g := if f x = a then x else invFunOn f P (k (f x))` and the same proof steps (`hka`/`hkP`/`hgP`/`hfg`, identity near the fibre via `eventually_nhds_iff`, injectivity via `hki`). The only differences are that the domain is a compact `Q` instead of `closedBall 0 1` and that the excluded fibre is over `{a, b}` instead of `{y}`.
